about.title: About
about.intro: I am Trần Quang Đạo, Software Development Team Leader at AIPTGROUP VIETNAM. I build specialised software and applied-AI systems for the security and defense sector — and lead the team that delivers them.
about.description1: My work covers real-time computer vision for access control and license plate recognition, video recovery and extraction from camera and NVR systems, AI video and audio analysis, and the internal platforms an organisation runs on — process automation and an AI chatbot over internal documents. Accuracy, latency and reproducible deployment matter more here than visual flourish.
about.description2: I work across the full stack — React and Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, Python and Flask — with OpenCV, YOLO and OCR for vision problems and Docker and CI/CD for delivery. Before AIPT I was Tech Leader at EPOSO AI, building an energy simulation platform for Samsung, and at INVESTY.

projects.title: Projects
AIPT Video Analyzer
projects.description: Forensic tool that recovers and extracts video from camera/DVR/NVR drives in proprietary formats Windows cannot read, including deleted footage.

detail.tagline: Recovers and extracts video from camera/DVR/NVR drives in formats Windows cannot read — including deleted footage.
overview: A forensic tool for recovering video evidence from surveillance storage. DVR and NVR systems write recordings to disk in proprietary on-disk formats that Windows does not recognise; this reads those formats directly from the drive and extracts the footage into standard, playable files.

Beyond what the recorder still lists, it reconstructs recordings that have been deleted or overwritten, working across different hard-drive and filesystem types. Recovered streams are transcoded with FFmpeg so they play in any browser, and the platform also connects to live camera and NVR feeds for review.
highlights: Reads proprietary DVR/NVR on-disk formats that Windows cannot mount, straight from the drive
Recovers deleted and overwritten footage, not only what the recorder still lists
Works across different hard-drive and filesystem types
Extracts recovered video to standard MP4, transcoded on the fly with FFmpeg
Live view and 24-hour playback for camera and NVR feeds

projects.title: AIPT Internal Process Web
projects.description: The modular web platform that runs AIPT’s operations — HRM and user management, tasks, inventory, projects and recruitment in one system.

detail.tagline: The web platform that runs AIPT’s operations — HRM, tasks, inventory, projects and recruitment in one modular system.
overview: A modular internal platform that runs the company’s day-to-day operations in one place. Each area of the business is its own module — HRM and user management, task and work tracking, inventory and warehouse, project management, recruitment and more — all sharing a single account and permission system.

It replaced scattered spreadsheets and ad-hoc tools with one web app, built with a React front end over a Flask API and MySQL, and shipped through Docker and CI/CD. It also acts as the host system that other internal tools, such as the ALICE chatbot, plug into.
highlights: Modular by design: HRM and user management, tasks, inventory, projects, recruitment
One shared account and role-based permission system across every module
Replaced scattered spreadsheets with a single operations platform
React + Flask + MySQL, containerised and deployed via CI/CD
Hosts other internal tools, including the ALICE chatbot

projects.title: Chatbot AI - ALICE
projects.description: An AI assistant that lets staff query the AIPT internal platform in natural language and get the data back, without navigating modules or writing queries.

detail.tagline: Ask the AIPT platform questions in plain language and get the data back.
overview: ALICE lets staff query the AIPT internal platform in natural language. Instead of navigating modules or writing queries, they ask a question — about people, tasks, inventory or projects — and ALICE pulls the answer straight from the platform’s data.
It is built into the internal process web it draws from, running as a separate service in a microservices setup so the AI layer can scale and deploy independently of the main application.
highlights: Natural-language access to the data held in the AIPT internal platform
Answers questions across modules without navigating the UI or writing queries
Embedded into the internal process web it draws its data from
Separate microservice — the AI layer scales and deploys on its own
React + Flask + MySQL, containerised with CI/CD

projects.title: AI-Assisted Meeting Management
projects.description: A meeting-intelligence platform: multi-language transcription, live analysis, file conversion, summaries and reports, with audio enhancement before processing.

detail.tagline: Transcribes meetings in multiple languages, then summarises, reports and analyses — live or from files.
overview: A meeting-intelligence platform that turns speech into text across multiple languages. It works live during a meeting or on uploaded recordings, and before transcribing it cleans the audio — noise reduction, echo cancellation and volume normalisation — so the transcript is accurate.

On top of transcription it analyses the conversation in real time, converts between file formats, and generates summaries and written reports. The audio models run on PyTorch behind a Flask + SocketIO backend, streaming results to the client as they are produced.
highlights: Multi-language speech-to-text, live or from uploaded files
Audio enhancement (noise, echo, volume) before transcription for accuracy
Real-time analysis, file-format conversion, summaries and auto-written reports
Streams results as they are produced over WebSocket (Flask-SocketIO)
PyTorch audio models, MySQL / MongoDB storage, containerised

projects.title: Video Master AI
projects.description: An AI platform that analyses live and recorded video at scale — detecting and filtering people, faces and vehicles — with dashboards, maps and reports.

detail.tagline: Analyses live and recorded video to detect people, faces and vehicles, with dashboards and reports.
overview: An AI platform for analysing surveillance and recorded video at scale. It detects and filters activity — people, faces and vehicles — across live feeds and stored footage, so operators can jump to the moments that matter instead of scrubbing through hours of video.

Results surface on a dashboard with maps and generated reports, streamed in real time over RESTful APIs and WebSocket. Detection runs on PyTorch models with PaddleOCR for text, FFmpeg handles the video pipeline, and the whole system runs either as a web app or a packaged desktop window.
highlights: Detects and filters people, faces and vehicles across live and recorded video
Lets operators jump to events instead of scrubbing hours of footage
Dashboard with maps and auto-generated reports
Real-time result streaming over RESTful APIs and WebSocket
PyTorch + PaddleOCR detection, FFmpeg pipeline; runs as web app or desktop

projects.title: People & License Plate Recognition
projects.description: A computer-vision access-control system that detects people and reads vehicle license plates from camera feeds in real time, turning video into entry/exit data.

detail.tagline: Computer-vision access control that detects people and reads license plates in real time.
overview: A computer-vision access-control system that watches camera feeds and identifies, in real time, the people and vehicles passing through. It detects people and reads vehicle license plates as they arrive, turning a raw video stream into structured entry and exit records.

Detection runs as a two-stage pipeline — a YOLO model locates people and plates, then an OCR stage reads the plate text — served from a Flask API with a React dashboard and PostgreSQL, all containerised with Docker. It was built for deployment in the security and defense sector, where accuracy and latency decide whether the system is usable at all.
highlights: Real-time person detection and license-plate recognition from camera streams
Two-stage pipeline: YOLO detection feeding an OCR stage for plate text
Turns a raw video stream into structured entry/exit records
Flask + React + PostgreSQL, containerised with Docker
Built for the security and defense sector

projects.title: Samsung Energy Simulator
projects.description: A smart energy-management platform built for Samsung, with a simulator that models usage scenarios and projects electricity cost savings per market.

detail.tagline: Simulates electricity cost savings across usage scenarios to guide energy decisions.
overview: A smart energy-management platform built for Samsung to help customers understand and cut their electricity costs. At its heart is a simulator that models different usage scenarios side by side and projects the savings from each, so decisions rest on real numbers rather than guesswork.

To make those numbers meaningful in each market, it carries localised electricity-pricing models for Vietnam, India and Thailand. Built on Next.js and NestJS over PostgreSQL and shipped with Docker and CI/CD — delivered as Tech Leader for an external client.
highlights: Simulator comparing energy-usage scenarios and projecting the savings of each
Localised electricity-pricing models for Vietnam, India and Thailand
Helps customers estimate cost savings and optimise consumption
Next.js + NestJS + PostgreSQL, containerised with CI/CD
Delivered as Tech Leader for an external client (Samsung)

projects.title: INVESTY Platform
projects.description: A platform connecting Vietnamese students and talent with opportunities abroad — a global job board, a freelance marketplace and course registration for Korean universities.

detail.tagline: Connects Vietnamese students and talent with global opportunities.
overview: A platform connecting Vietnamese students and talent with opportunities abroad. It brings together a global job board, a freelance marketplace for project-based hiring, and a course-registration module for Korean universities — three ways for users to find work or study internationally, in one place.

The real-time features — messaging and live updates — run over WebSocket with Firebase, on a React / Redux front end and a Node.js + MongoDB backend. Delivered as Tech Leader, owning the architecture across all three products.
highlights: Global job-connection platform linking Vietnamese talent with opportunities abroad
Freelance marketplace for project-based hiring
Course-registration module for Korean universities
Real-time messaging and live updates over WebSocket + Firebase
React / Redux front end, Node.js + MongoDB backend

projects.title: Data Extraction Tool - LYNX
projects.description: A desktop console for administering a fleet of enrolled Android devices — inventory, status and remote administration from one dashboard.

detail.tagline: A desktop console for managing a fleet of enrolled Android devices from one place.
overview: LYNX is a desktop console for administering a fleet of enrolled Android devices from one place. It gives an operator a single dashboard over every device — inventory, live status and remote administration for an authorised fleet — rather than managing each handset by hand.
On each device a Java agent reports in to a central Node.js server, and operators work through an Electron desktop client. It was built for deployment in the security and defense sector.
highlights: Single console for an enrolled Android device fleet
Device inventory, live status and remote administration
Per-device Java agent reporting to a central Node.js server
Electron desktop client for operators
Built for the security and defense sector
